title: 第17章 弟子宁愿退出湮鼎宗第18章 残破丹炉
lines: “吱吱。”
抚摸着小胖龙的脑袋，林铮很是满意。
这次要不是靠着小胖龙斥退龙蟒，自己面对洞天境妖兽，恐怕很难活着离开。
就在林铮准备离开的时候。
眼神顿时一凝，发现刚刚离开的龙蟒去而复返。
立刻警惕起来，并且林铮已经做好出手的准备。
“吱吱，吱吱。”
“嘶嘶，嘶嘶。”
林铮皱着眉头，他能看的出来，如今的龙蟒正在和小胖龙交流着。
交流了一会。
龙蟒突然张开嘴，一枚枚拳头大小，通体黑红色的果子吐了出来，大概有着上百枚，龙蟒朝着小胖龙点点头转身离去。
“龙蟒给你的？”
小胖龙点点头，从林铮的怀里跳下去，捧起一枚果子开始吞食起来。
‘小子，这是龙蜒果，极其稀有，并且刚刚摘下来，无法保存’
“我吞食，对我的修炼有用吗？”
‘上百枚足以让你筑基’
听到‘筑基’两字，林铮彻底不淡定起来。
先天境，聚灵境，筑基境，凝轮境，归一境，洞天境为武道基础六境。
如今的他只是刚刚稳定在八重聚灵境，哪怕是当初巅峰时期的自己，也只是突破到巅峰聚灵境。
筑基，对于武者来说至关重要。
一把抱起小胖龙，任由小胖龙反抗，直接阻止小胖继续吞食龙蜒果。
“稍后我给你找其他食物，这些龙蜒果我有急用。”
无视小胖龙。
没有继续犹豫，林铮立刻开始吞食龙蜒果，一枚枚龙蜒果源源不断的被放入嘴里。
弑神塔悬浮在林铮的头顶上空，塔灵释放出霸道的吞噬力量，相助林铮炼化融合龙蜒果。
夜幕降临。
黑漆漆的虚空，使得整个山脉越发阴森起来。
缓缓睁开双眼，林铮脸上写满了惊喜，他也没有想到，吞食百枚龙蜒果，居然能让他一举突破到筑基境。
紧接着，脑海突然涌现出两门武学。
一门闪电剑诀，一门追云步，剑诀配身法，完美配合。
“塔爷，为何两门武学都没有品级。”
林铮当然知道，两门武学都是之前塔灵给自己元神强行灌入，随着自己的修为不断提升，元神会源源不断涌出各种武学。
“你无需知道武学品级，只要记住，任何武学只要适合你，那就是最好的品级，否则的话，品级再高，不适合也是无用。”
“说的有道理。”
稍稍参悟后，林铮便起身离开。
这次追饕餮幼崽，和师父走散，恐怕师父会担心自己。
“臭小子，到底死哪里去了，要是你出现意外，我无法向火魅交代。”
“师父，你要向谁交代。”
听到身后传来的声音，火玄脸色顿时一喜，急忙转身。
content_en:
"Zhizhi."
Lin Zheng was very satisfied after stroking the little fat dragon's head.
If it weren't for the little fat dragon to repel the dragon python this time, it would be difficult to leave alive when facing the cave-heaven realm monsters by myself.
Just when Lin Zheng was about to leave.
His eyes suddenly condensed, and he found that the dragon python that had just left had returned.
He immediately became vigilant and Lin Zheng was ready to take action.
"Squeak, squeak."
"Hiss, hiss."
Lin Zheng frowned. He could see that the dragon python was communicating with the little fat dragon.
We communicated for a while.
The dragon python suddenly opened its mouth and spit out fist-sized, black-red fruits. There were probably hundreds of them. The dragon python nodded towards the little fat dragon and turned around to leave.
"Dragon python gave it to you?"
The little fat dragon nodded, jumped out of Lin Zheng's arms, picked up a piece of fruit and started to devour it.
‘Boy, this is a dragon fruit. It is extremely rare. It has just been picked and cannot be preserved.’
"If I swallow it, will it be useful for my cultivation?"
‘Hundreds of them are enough for you to build a foundation’
Hearing the word 'foundation building', Lin Zheng became completely uneasy.
The Xiantian Realm, Gathering Spirit Realm, Foundation Building Realm, Condensing Wheel Realm, Returning to One Realm, and Dongtian Realm are the six basic realms of martial arts.
Now, he has just stabilized at the eighth level of spirit gathering realm. Even when he was at his peak, he had only broken through to the peak spirit gathering realm.
Foundation building is crucial for warriors.
He picked up the little fat dragon and allowed the little fat dragon to resist, directly preventing the little fat dragon from continuing to swallow the dragon fruit.
"I'll find other food for you later. I need these dragon fruit in a hurry."
Ignore the little fat dragon.
Without further hesitation, Lin Zheng immediately began to swallow the dragon fruit, and one after another the dragon fruit was put into his mouth.
The God-killing Tower was suspended above Lin Zheng's head, and the tower spirit released its overbearing devouring power to help Lin Zheng refine and fuse the dragon fruit.
Night falls.
The pitch-black void made the entire mountain range even more gloomy.
Slowly opening his eyes, Lin Zheng's face was filled with surprise. He did not expect that swallowing hundreds of dragon fruit would actually allow him to break through to the foundation building realm in one fell swoop.
Immediately afterwards, two martial arts suddenly emerged in his mind.
One Lightning Sword Technique and the other Cloud Chasing Step. The sword techniques and body movements work together perfectly.
"Master Ta, why do both martial arts have no grades?"
Of course Lin Zheng knew that the two martial arts were forcibly poured into his soul by the tower spirit before. As his cultivation level continued to improve, the soul would continuously pour out various martial arts.
"You don't need to know the level of martial arts. Just remember that as long as any martial arts is suitable for you, it is the best level. Otherwise, no matter how high the level is, it is useless if it is not suitable for you."
"That makes sense."
After a little reflection, Lin Zheng stood up and left.
This time I chased the Taotie cub and got separated from the master. I was afraid that the master would worry about me.
"You brat, where did you die? If something happens to you, I can't explain it to Huo Mei."
"Master, who do you want to answer to?"
Hearing the voice coming from behind, Huo Xuan's face suddenly became happy and he turned around hurriedly.
